subject.title: Models: fully dynamic model discovery (OpenRouter + beyond)

question: Should OpenClaw make live provider model discovery the default catalog/list/picker behavior, or keep dynamic discovery limited to explicit provider wildcards and provider-specific flows?
rationale: The remaining choice affects provider API contracts, config semantics, model selection UX, offline caching, and safety/cost policy, which cannot be resolved from source inspection alone.

options.title: Design umbrella stays open
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical product decision while reviewing narrower implementation PRs such as the OpenAI-compatible /v1/models work against the chosen API contract.

options.title: Split by provider
options.body: Convert this umbrella into provider-specific issues so OpenRouter, OpenAI-compatible providers, and future plugins can each land independently with documented discovery semantics.

options.title: Limit to explicit wildcards
options.body: Declare provider/* configuration the supported dynamic-discovery surface and close broader default list/picker discovery as out of scope.

recommendation.title: Design umbrella stays open
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the canonical product decision while reviewing narrower implementation PRs such as the OpenAI-compatible /v1/models work against the chosen API contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent main history shows Peter Steinberger on the dynamic OpenRouter runtime and capability-cache implementation that this decision would extend.
